verdict.rationale: A hands-on community report shows Groq publishing a per-token API price (0.27/1M tokens), and the docs refer to on-demand pricing and batch discounts. However, another community report says Groq switched to 'call us for quotes' for newer models, which undercuts the 'every hosted model, without sales' part of the story. missing for 10: a first-party public pricing page in the evidence, per-token prices for every hosted model, and confirmation that no models require a sales quote.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see public per-token prices for every hosted model without talking to sales

citations.quote: I am even more impressed by the API pricing though - 0.27/1M tokens seems like an order of magnitude cheaper than the GPT-3.5 API.
